beats.say: Heads up: Grand Theft Auto VI will not have a physical disc.
According to The Hollywood Reporter, the base game costs 79 dollars and 99 cents.
The report says the Ultimate edition is priced at 99 dollars and 99 cents.
The Hollywood Reporter also reveals development cost between 1 billion and 1.5 billion dollars.
Release is set for 19 November 2026, and digital download is your only option.

facts: There will be no physical version of Grand Theft Auto VI.
The base version of Grand Theft Auto VI costs $79.99.
The Ultimate edition of Grand Theft Auto VI costs $99.99.
Rockstar Games spent between $1 billion and $1.5 billion developing Grand Theft Auto VI.
Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled for release on 19 November 2026.
